messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm starting a short push to harmonize naming across docs + SDK snippets. Found a few inconsistent tokens: `model_variant` vs `model variant`, 'route' vs 'endpoint', and 'rollout' used interchangeably with 'deployment'. Want to lock a tiny glossary and a quick PR checklist. :thinking_face:
mira: agree, those are confusing for new users. can we avoid underscores in public examples? e.g., prefer `modelVariant` or `model variant` depending on the surface.
dan: +1 on avoiding underscores in prose. For SDK code we should mirror actual param names though (so keep `model_variant` if the SDK param is literally that).
kevin: propose: docs prose = human-readable (space-separated), SDK snippets = exact code identifiers. we should add a short note in the style guide to explain the mapping.
luis: also spotted a bunch of old links in migration-guide.md that point to the legacy deploy flow. I can open a PR to update to /platform/deploy -> /guides/deploy if folks want.
alex: perfect. Plan suggestion: 1) small glossary doc (one-pager) with canonical forms 2) style-note for prose vs code 3) sweep PR to change copy + snippets + links. Who can own each?
mira: I can draft the glossary one-pager. will keep it <300 words and include 6 canonical terms. aiming for a PR by EOD tomorrow.
dan: I can do the style-note for prose vs code. i'll include examples for JavaScript + Python snippets. will reference the glossary in the header.
kevin: I'll take the links sweep. quick question: when we change copy in guides used by the SDK, should we also add a short compatibility note in the changelog?
alex: yes, add a small changelog entry. audience: platform users and integrators. not necessary for every tiny phrasing change but for anything that could break copy/paste snippets.
luis: opening an umbrella PR to bundle link fixes and obvious snippet updates might reduce churn. i'll coordinate the branch name: `docs/term-harmonize/<owner>` and i'll open a draft PR early. want reviews from docs + SDK owners.
mira: fyi, glossary candidate terms: "model variant", "model family", "route", "endpoint", "canary deploy", "dedicated pool". thoughts?
dan: swap "canary deploy" -> "canary rollout"? We use 'rollout' elsewhere in ops. pick one. my vote: "rollout" (noun) and keep "deploy" for action verbs.
eke: Sorry — small nit: use consistent casing in UI examples: Title Case for UI labels, sentence case for docs headings.
kevin: +1 for 'rollout' noun. also we should add a short regex check in docs-lint CI to flag legacy tokens like `model_variant`.
alex: good idea. I'll file a follow-up issue to add a docs-lint rule: detect snake_case tokens in prose and warn. keep code blocks exempt.
mira: drafting glossary now. looping in @dan for code examples and @kevin for link checks.
docs-bot: Reminder: new draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 (docs/term-harmonize/mira) — auto-tagged 'docs' and 'needs-review'.
luis: nice, i'll add my link fixes in a separate commit on that branch.
dan: for SDK snippets, i'll include explicit code blocks like:
```js
// JS example: prefer camelCase when used as JS param names
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/fast-7b', modelVariant: 'v1' })
```
and a Python example with snake_case matching actual SDK param names.
mira: quick question — do we want the glossary to include deprecation guidance? e.g., "old_token" -> "new_token" mapping table.
alex: yes, include a short mapping table (2-3 items) and mark as informal until we complete the sweep.
kevin: timeline: can we aim to merge the draft PR by end of week? ops team wants to start on rollout docs early next week.
mira: should be doable. i'll get the draft up tonight. request reviews from @alex @dan @kevin.
luis: cc: @security for any phrase that touches VPC/on-prem naming — they may have preferences.
dan: I'll add the code snippet tests to the PR so CI fails if snippets stop compiling (simple lint check).
alex: awesome. last item: naming for the glossary file itself: prefer 'docs/glossary/naming.md' rather than 'glossary.md' at repo root. keeps scoped.
mira: done. adding initial file path suggestion in the PR.
docs-bot: PR 512 updated: reviewers requested: alex, dan, kevin.
kevin: quick follow-up: if anyone spots ambiguous usage in the Console UI, drop a screenshot in the PR so product can triage.
alex: thanks all. action items: mira -> draft glossary PR; dan -> style-note + code examples; kevin -> link sweep + regex rule issue; luis -> bundle link fixes on branch; alex -> open docs-lint issue + add changelog guidance. Will reconvene after PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
mira: thanks, closing loop. :rocket:
